title: predict.cancel.v1
description: Phase 9.5 — emitted when a prediction request is cancelled before a response is written. Producer set bounded to api.gateway.v1. Carries the original request_id so downstream consumers can correlate with api.request.v1 and api.response.v1 events.

request_id.description: The request id minted at gateway ingress; matches request_id in the corresponding api.request.v1 event.

cancelled_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the cancellation was detected at the gateway.

reason.description: Cause of cancellation. client_disconnect: client closed the connection before the response was written. deadline_exceeded: request exceeded its configured timeout. operator_kill: manually cancelled by an operator action.
